description: This file defines constants, macros, data structures, and configuration for the NXP MPU (Memory Protection Unit) in the Zephyr RTOS, including access permissions, region attributes, and configuration structures.

classes.name: nxp_mpu_region
classes.description: Structure representing an MPU region with base address, end address, name, and attributes.

classes.name: nxp_mpu_config
classes.description: Structure holding MPU configuration including number of regions, region array, and SRAM region.

methods.name: MPU_REGION_ENTRY
methods.description: Macro to initialize an nxp_mpu_region structure with name, base, end, and attributes.
